cues: A salt of a strong acid and strong base, like sodium chloride, does not hydrolyse at all.
Weak acid and strong base, the anion hydrolyses, alkaline.
Strong acid and weak base, like ammonium chloride, the cation gives up a proton, acidic.
Weak acid and weak base, both ions hydrolyse, and the result depends on which constant is bigger.
text: There are four cases. A salt of a strong acid and strong base, like sodium chloride, does not hydrolyse at all. Weak acid and strong base, the anion hydrolyses, alkaline. Strong acid and weak base, like ammonium chloride, the cation gives up a proton, acidic. Weak acid and weak base, both ions hydrolyse, and the result depends on which constant is bigger.
